# HagiSoul

> HagiSoul is a browser-based builder for creating, sharing and browsing Souls. A Soul is assembled from a base role and expression rules, and the finished preview can be copied. The site is a single interactive app, available in 10 languages.

## Builder

- [HagiSoul: Agent Soul Editor](https://soul.hagicode.com/): Pick a base role and expression rules, then copy the Soul preview.

## Optional

- [HagiCode, the agentic coding workspace](https://www.hagicode.com/)
- [HagiCode documentation](https://docs.hagicode.com/)
